name: happyhorse-1.0-t2v
description: HappyHorse 1.0 T2V is an open-source text-to-video generation model from Alibaba DAMO Academy’s Future Life Lab. Built on a 15B-parameter single-stream self-attention Transformer architecture, it is designed to understand complex camera language, spatial relationships, and multi-character scenes, enabling high-quality 1080P video generation from text prompts. The model supports multiple resolutions and aspect ratios, making it suitable for cinematic creation, marketing videos, social media content, and multi-format video production.
zhDescription: happyhorse-1.0-t2v 是阿里达摩院未来生活实验室开源的文本生成视频模型，采用 15B 参数单流自注意力 Transformer 架构，面向高质量文生视频场景。模型具备较强的语义理解、镜头语言解析和多角色场景生成能力，可输出电影级 1080P 视频，并支持多分辨率与多宽高比，适合广告创意、剧情分镜、营销短片、社媒视频等多平台内容生产。
longDescription: HappyHorse 1.0 T2V is an open-source text-to-video generation model from Alibaba DAMO Academy’s Future Life Lab. Built on a 15B-parameter single-stream self-attention Transformer architecture, it is designed to understand complex camera language, spatial relationships, and multi-character scenes, enabling high-quality 1080P video generation from text prompts. The model supports multiple resolutions and aspect ratios, making it suitable for cinematic creation, marketing videos, social media content, and multi-format video production.
zhLongDescription: 阿里达摩院未来生活实验室开源的视频生成模型，支持文本到视频的高质量生成。采用15B参数单流自注意力Transformer架构，能够精准理解复杂镜头语言和多角色对话，生成具有电影级画质的1080P视频。模型支持多分辨率输出(720P/1080P)，提供16:9、9:16、1:1、4:3等多种宽高比，满足横屏、竖屏、方屏等不同平台需求。
